response.sql: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, order_volume, 1.0 * order_volume / NULLIF(SUM(order_volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volumes), shares_with_average AS (SELECT order_volume, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(order_volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
